Here in California, economic conditions remain solid, even though the pace of expansion
has slowed quite a bit in recent months.

For example, vacancies are up and lease rates are falling in some commercial
office markets.

On top of that, the recent increase in electricity rates for much of the state will
average out over a year to almost 1% of median household income for the state.

Although higher retail electricity rates will help reduce demand, we still face the
threat of forced outages this summer.
